headline: Digital Marketing Strategist | Performance Marketing Specialist
summary: Data-driven Digital Marketing professional with over 6 years of experience in scaling growth for Nepal's leading e-commerce and ride-sharing platforms. Expert in performance marketing, campaign optimization, and ROI-focused strategies. Proven ability to manage high-volume budgets and deliver measurable growth in user acquisition and retention.

experiences.title: Senior Performance Marketing Lead
description: Developed and executed full-funnel digital marketing strategies for Ride, Food, and Bazaar verticals, resulting in a 45% increase in Monthly Active Users (MAU) within 18 months.
Managed a monthly advertising budget of NPR 2.5 million across Meta, Google Ads, and TikTok, maintaining an average Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC) 15% below target.
Scaled app installations by 200,000+ through optimized Google Universal App Campaigns (UAC) and localized creative testing.
Collaborated with the data team to implement advanced event tracking, improving conversion attribution accuracy by 30%.

experiences.title: Digital Marketing Executive
description: Led the digital execution for major shopping festivals including 11.11 and 12.12, achieving a record-breaking 12x ROAS on Meta advertising spend.
Managed and optimized the Daraz Affiliate Program, growing the active affiliate network by 40% and contributing to 8% of total platform GMV.
Executed A/B testing on landing pages and ad copies that improved click-through rates (CTR) by 22% for the electronics category.
Coordinated with the regional marketing team in Pakistan and Bangladesh to align cross-border campaign strategies and localized content.

experiences.title: SEO & Content Marketing Specialist
description: Performed technical SEO audits and on-page optimization for 15+ local and international clients, increasing organic traffic by an average of 60%.
Managed a team of content writers to produce SEO-optimized blog posts and landing pages, ranking 50+ high-competition keywords on the first page of Google.
Implemented local SEO strategies for Nepali hospitality brands, leading to a 40% increase in Google Maps visibility and direct bookings.
